name: @cflow/index
description: A Bun-powered TypeScript monorepo for cflow.

scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run format:check && bun run test && bun run test:browser && bun run build && bun run docs:check
scripts.docs:check: bun run docs:verify && bun run docs:quick-start && bun run docs:build
scripts.docs:quick-start: bun run --filter '@cflow/core' build && bun run website/examples/quick-start.ts
scripts.build: bun run build:root && bun run --filter '@cflow/core' build && bun run --filter '@cflow/renderer-svg' build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter '@cflow/core' build && tsgo --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/diagnostics/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/kernel/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/session-api/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/interaction-api/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/renderer-api/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/renderer-svg/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/runtime-cordis/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/plugin-command/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/plugin-kernel/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/plugin-session/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/plugin-renderer/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/plugin-interaction/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/plugin-history/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/preset-basic/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/layout-api/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/layout-dagre/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/layout-elk/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/plugin-layout/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json
